HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:DISTANT SUN (1) has been racing super without winning recently. She has been flashing home well late and gets a change of luck here with the better barrier. PARIS KAY (7) got it wrong with her manners last start, so we can forget that run. Her start prior was a second in the Swan Hill Trotters Cup, where she ran well chasing down the getaway winner. She is one of the classier horses in this race, but the barrier is tricky. LITTLE MISS MORGAN (9) is a smart mare who won well last start at Maryborough, flashing home from last. She beat DISTANT SUN (1) on that occasion, however, the barrier suits DISTANT SUN (1) here. ZARSKI (4) has a massive motor and a lot of ability, but his quirks bring risk. He galloped last start and can do things wrong. If he’s on his best behaviour, he’s one of, if not the most talented horses in this field. Also respecting WALLIS (2), who let down nicely for third last start. With some luck, he can be prominent here. BACK: DISTANT SUN (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DISTANT SUN (1), PARIS KAY (7), LITTLE MISS MORGAN (9), ZARSKI (4)

OVERVIEW:ICANMOTOR (9) is a 20-time winner and finds a suitable race here, particularly with a maiden also in the field. He’s been out of the winner’s circle since finding a purple patch of form late last year. He sustained a three-wide run last start and still battled on well for fifth. He’s racing okay and barrier nine suits. FAKE CULLECTION (10) needs to overcome a wide back-row barrier, but she is racing okay. She was narrowly beaten at Kilmore last start after flashing home brilliantly. IMAGUNNARESTNGO (7) was in a race restricted to NR up to 45 last start and drops back to NR up to 38 here. It was an interesting run, as he seemed to be struggling to keep up with the horses in front of him at the bell, but then picked up the bit again late and let down okay. He’s not the fastest beginner, so he will likely drift back to the rear of the field and need some luck, but it’s a suitable race. OKTOLOVE (6) is one for the exotics if he gets some luck. If JOEYS HANGOVER (10), the emergency, gains a start, he’s a winning chance and would have likely been my top selection. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (9), FAKE CULLECTION (10), IMAGUNNARESTNGO (7), OKTOLOVE (6)

OVERVIEW:TED BEAR (9) won impressively two starts ago at Melton, flashing around the field to win. Last start, he tired after leading. If he’s saved for one run here, he will be flashing home late. LORIMERMAJOR (2) was second behind the smart mare Harley Lane recently at Kilmore. He had barrier two on that occasion, settled midfield and flashed home impressively once he found clear running. He’s an experienced horse who can run well here with some luck. ANIMADO (1) was third last start after leading and tiring in the late stages. He can place again here from the barrier. CATIES SON (3) is third-up here and should be back to near peak fitness. Forget last start, when he hit the barrier arm and galloped, but still let down well late after catching the field. He is a smart horse at his best. BACK: TED BEAR (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TED BEAR (9), LORIMERMAJOR (2), ANIMADO (1), CATIES SON (3)

OVERVIEW: This is an interesting race with many first starters. CATCH A BUTTERFLY (9) has all the ticks on paper to make her a nice filly. She is a full sister to Catch A Wave and a half-sister to Yambukian. She is trained by Emma Stewart and her trial form has been good, albeit in slow time. Looking forward to following this filly. ALWAYS BE VICKI (6) is a New Zealand-bred filly for Craig Demmler having her first career start. She has looked really good, winning her two Melton trials. In both trials, she was strong to the line but also under a grip, looking like she has a lot to offer. LIL SPARROW (3) is having her first career start for Kristy Butler. She won her recent trial at Shepparton and we will learn more about her here. FLYING JACKIE (2) has one career start. She got shuffled back at Shepparton and hit the line well for second. If she had been on the fence, her final quarter would have been 27.8. If she finds a good race map here, she could be flashing home again. Also respecting ASHANTE MAJOR (8), who is out of superstar broodmare For Dear Life, making him a half-brother to Pelosi. He’s bred to be a nice horse. SELECTIONS: CATCH A BUTTERFLY (9), ALWAYS BE VICKI (6), LIL SPARROW (3), FLYING JACKIE (2)

OVERVIEW:BUSLIN BRODY (9) has had some mixed form recently when it comes to his manners. He has been getting it wrong and galloping early. However, when he has been trotting throughout, he appears to be near career-best form. Hoping he can settle here from barrier nine, do everything right and be the one crossing the line first. I CHOOSE YOU (6) flashed home well from last to finish fourth last start at Maryborough. His class was on show recently against the top level of the three-year-old trotters when he finished second behind Munny The Munster in a Vicbred Super Series heat. He can get things wrong with his manners. RASTAMON (2) has good gate speed and will likely find the fence here. He performs best when he finds the fence and is racing well. PASS THE SALT (5) is a nice horse at his best. He was shuffled back last start at Maryborough but still let down well late. BACK: BUSLIN BRODY (9)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BUSLIN BRODY (9), I CHOOSE YOU (6), RASTAMON (2), PASS THE SALT (5)

OVERVIEW:RAPTA (4) has a lot of ability when he trots throughout. Four starts ago, he ran an eye-catching second in a Need For Speed heat against a top-quality field. Since then, he has recorded another good placing and galloped twice. If he trots, he is the one to beat here. MOONSHINE LOUIE (2) has been racing well. He hasn’t been out of the top four in eight starts. He can make his own luck and should be able to map well here from barrier two. KYVALLEY REEVA (7) can get it wrong with her manners, but when she trots, she trots impressively. She galloped last start, but her two starts prior saw her trot throughout and win very well. If she trots, she can win. ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5) has a strong last 800 metres on the clock at her best. If she gets a good trip, she can be flashing home late. BACK: RAPTA (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RAPTA (4), MOONSHINE LOUIE (2), KYVALLEY REEVA (7), ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5)

OVERVIEW:KIMCHI (5) is a reliable performer who is in good form. He let down nicely from midfield to win two starts ago at Kilmore. Last start, he was three-wide with cover for the last lap and sprinted well late for second. He has another sticky barrier, but he’s versatile enough to make his own luck. OUR MYSTERY BET (1) is a consistent performer who will get a good fence trip here. TASTE IT (7) sustained a good three-wide trip to win well last start. She is racing well, but her barrier makes it tricky here. HOME AND DRY (2) was unlucky last start, held up before running home nicely once he found clear air. He has a better barrier here and gets a chance for a change of luck. BACK: KIMCHI (5)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KIMCHI (5), OUR MYSTERY BET (1), TASTE IT (7), HOME AND DRY (2)

OVERVIEW:WHIRILY MAURZ (1) is in career-best form, winning her last two starts very well. She has the best sectional times on paper and is full of confidence. She can win again. The biggest risk to her chances is her gate speed. The horses drawn to her outside, especially HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2), have better-known gate speed than her. She is a massive chance if she can hold a forward position. HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2) does look likely to find the fence here and, from there, can take advantage of a good trip. KNOW THE SCORE (3), at his best, is a winning chance in this field. There are a few question marks around some of his recent runs, but if he can map well here, he may find a chance to get back into form. THE HEATS ON LEXY (4) could map as the horse flashing home late if she gets some luck. ABRAHAM (8) is first up in 52 days and is having his first look at the Kilmore track. SELECTIONS: WHIRILY MAURZ (1), HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2), KNOW THE SCORE (3), THE HEATS ON LEXY (4)

OVERVIEW:FROSTY DROP (1) is a smart filly with great gate speed and general high speed. If she can stay close to the front, take advantage of her fence barrier and avoid having to work too hard, she’s a big winning chance here. BLACKINDEED (3) is fourth-up here and should be close to peak race fitness. She has finished third at her last two starts and let down well last start. If she can map well, she will be in the finish. RAKAROMPA (4) is a lightly raced mare who is second-up here. She let down nicely for second last start and I am expecting an improved performance with added fitness. TRYX VIXEN (5) is a smart filly who rarely runs a bad race, but she has a sticky barrier here. SELECTIONS: FROSTY DROP (1), BLACKINDEED (3), RAKAROMPA (4), TRYX VIXEN (5) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:SOLS ME NAME (4) is first up since tiring in the Vicbred Super Series Semi-Final in September. While it was a Group 1 series against the best horses in his age group, he did appear below his best in that performance. He was a good third in his heat the week prior. He is a classy horse at his best, remains lightly raced and has won two recent trials. BANJO STAR (2) is racing better than his numerical form suggests. He got too wide and too far back last start, making it difficult to make up ground. His previous effort was a smart fourth at Wagga in good time. MISTER HUNTER (9) is one of the best horses in this race on ability. He has 11 starts for six wins, including a Group 1 success in the APG Gold Bullion as a two-year-old in 2023. However, he hasn't raced since June 2024, and that was his only start since May 2023. He has had just two recent trials, making this a massive ask. First up after 865 days and now competing outside aged-group racing, he will need to be very sharp to win. DELIGHTFUL MIKI (1) is a smart, lightly raced mare who gets the ace barrier and the opportunity to use it to her advantage. Also strongly respecting ALOT LIKE JEANNIE (8), who has been racing at the top level among the three-year-old fillies this season. She won a Vicbred Super Series heat and possesses a brilliant turn of foot. She will need some luck from the barrier. BACK: SOLS ME NAME (4)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SOLS ME NAME (4), BANJO STAR (2), MISTER HUNTER (9), DELIGHTFUL MIKI (1)

OVERVIEW: This race is full of progressive horses, making it a very competitive event. MASTER LOUEY (10) is a smart colt who rarely runs a bad race. He put together some really nice performances before winning well last start after leading at Ballarat. This assignment will be harder, as he is unlikely to find the front and will be racing over the short trip. However, he has the class to be competitive. STORM VENDETTA (6) contested the same race won by Master Louey last start but was too far back and wide to make up the ground. He defeated MASTER LOUEY (10) three starts ago at Ballarat, coming off his back to run past him. He has a great turn of foot, although the barrier makes things tricky. TOORAM DANNY (9) flashed home strongly at Echuca last start and was only narrowly defeated. He rarely runs a bad race and should get a good trip, following through early into the running line. SIR NIPPA (3) is first up back in Victoria following a campaign in Tasmania and could appreciate the change of scenery. HOLLOW LOG (4), METRO MEMORY (5), SAVANNAH BREEZE (7) and CHAINSMOKE (11) are all capable of featuring with the right luck in what looks a very even field. SELECTIONS: MASTER LOUEY (10), STORM VENDETTA (6), TOORAM DANNY (9), SIR NIPPA (3)

OVERVIEW:TALISKER SKIPPER (11) is in good form after winning well at Kilmore last start when leading. He will need to make his own luck from barrier 11 here, but his best sectional times are around two seconds quicker than the rest of this field. ARTY MCFLY (3) is a two-year-old having his fourth career start. He is first up here after finishing fifth in the $100,000 APG Final last start. This is his first attempt outside two-year-old racing. HALF PRICE BRIDE (9) was too wide and too far back to make up the ground at Echuca last start. She has been a little unlucky recently but finds an opportunity to turn her form around if she can map well. THE IRISHMAN (1) is a horse who isn't afraid to do some work in his races. He is racing well and gets the ace barrier, which he can use to his advantage. Also respecting CHEEZ (8), who is first up for new trainer Tasmyn Potter. SELECTIONS: TALISKER SKIPPER (11), ARTY MCFLY (3), HALF PRICE BRIDE (9), THE IRISHMAN (1),

OVERVIEW:DANCE FIGHTER (7) was a dominant winner at Maryborough last start when leading. It was a slowly run race, but she let down nicely and got the job done. She has been racing well and comes into this with winning confidence. This assignment will be tougher from the barrier. OLIVER SMUDGE (3) was eye-catching when returning with a win last start after three years on the sidelines. He galloped early, caught the field, made his move around them and was too good when letting down late. He will improve again with fitness, but his manners remain a big risk. SHINELIKETHESUN (5) is the best swooper in this field on the clock. If she is close enough, she is good enough, but she comes with some risk after galloping at her last four starts. ELARIA (1) is having her third career start. She finished third on debut at Maryborough, doing everything right and running safely to the line. She galloped last start, although it appeared she may have suffered some interference that caused her to break stride. She recovered and ran on reasonably well. She should produce an improved performance here with added fitness. SELECTIONS: DANCE FIGHTER (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (3), SHINELIKETHESUN (5), ELARIA (1)

OVERVIEW:WIND STORM (8) was an impressive first-up winner at Maryborough last start, racing away to score by 21.9 metres. She has the best sectional times in this field, but will need to overcome the tricky barrier eight. FRANKS ALOT (2) is an interesting trotter. He raced in the breeze to finish a good second on debut, then followed that up with a dominant win at Maryborough before getting it wrong with his manners last start. If he can trot throughout and get forward, he will be a big threat. BIRMINGHAM GIRL (1) was good on debut when finishing third but got it wrong with her manners at Kilmore last start. She will need to trot throughout here. BIG RAIN (5) is a well-mannered trotter who is always competitive. With the right run and some luck, she can capitalise. BACK: WIND STORM (8) –2 units (win) SELECTIONS: WIND STORM (8), FRANKS ALOT (2), BIRMINGHAM GIRL (1), BIG RAIN (5)

OVERVIEW:BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1) returns from a short campaign in Tasmania. He had a tough run but still finished fifth in the $75,000 Dandy Patch Final at Hobart last start after winning his heat. He is a classy runner, but faces the challenge of being a two-year-old competing against older horses. Barrier one certainly suits. BEAU BECA (2) led and battled on well for second at Kilmore last start. He is racing okay and should map well here. ARTIST (6) has been racing reasonably well, although he can be a little inconsistent. He finished fifth last start after racing in the breeze. Barrier six makes things tricky, but at his best he is a winning chance. BONA KHAN (3) is a fast horse who can be effective whether saved for one run or using his gate speed. If he gets some luck here, he cannot be forgotten. BACK: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1)– 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1), BEAU BECA (2), ARTIST (6), BONA KHAN (3)

OVERVIEW: This looks a very even maiden with plenty of chances. Any horse in this field could win, and it wouldn't come as a surprise. EVA EXPRESS (7) has been racing okay. She led and took a sit at Kilmore last start before running home well to be beaten by a neck. She faces a more challenging barrier here, but should continue to improve, with this being just her fifth career start. SPOT THE DEVIL (1) flashed home nicely to finish third in the same race last start. He gets a change of luck here with barrier one, a draw he has had only once previously in his 48 career starts. ITS JUST RUBY (2) looked physically outstanding at Kilmore last start. I was on track before the race and she really caught my eye. She also performed better than the market suggested. She was shuffled back to last but ran home well, and gets a much better barrier here. She has the gate speed to make use of the draw and could be an improver in this event. DYGANALI (6) has been racing okay and looks ready to break through for his maiden victory. Barrier six is the main challenge. BACK: ITS JUST RUBY (2)– 1 unit (win)/ 2 units (place) SELECTIONS: EVA EXPRESS (7), SPOT THE DEVIL (1), ITS JUST RUBY (2), DYGANALI (6)

OVERVIEW:UNCLE TREV (6) has been racing regularly at Shepparton and Wagga recently and gets his first look at Melton here. He is a smart horse who rarely runs a bad race and has the best sectional times in this event. The barrier makes things difficult, but his class should shine through. SPRINGFIELD RIVER (5) is a progressive pacer who I believe we haven't seen the best of yet. He was a good second last start in a tough race, chasing runaway leaders and letting down nicely. The barrier is awkward here, but he is racing well. SPEEDY HEALEY (3) rarely runs a bad race and is always capable of letting down nicely when he gets a good trip. THEROUX (2) was inconvenienced last start when dragged back, but still managed to let down reasonably well. He is racing well and should map positively here. SELECTIONS: UNCLE TREV (6), SPRINGFIELD RIVER (5), SPEEDY HEALEY (3), THEROUX (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

HEZROCKINROYALTY (4) finds his sort of race today. He ran second behind LOCHINVAR MAGIC and hit the line well. He looks the one to beat. LOCHINVAR LEADER (1) will find this race tougher but he will love the inside draw and the track. He is a major threat. LORD ZARIAS (5) and NAROBI (2) are also chances.

SWEETHEARTED (4) has won both her trials at Globe Derby and Gawler. She ran a 1.57.9 mile rate at Gawler in her most recent trial. She looks like a promising filly and a big threat tonight. TIGER MUMFF (2), GETONTHEBUS (6) and MAJOR APDAL (5) are also chances.

SWEET NICKY (4) ran second behind NORMANS GIRL last start here at Port Pirie which was her first run in SA. She should be able to improve off that run. She should be hard to beat today. ROLL WITH MUSTARD (7) finds the sort of race he can win today. If he can get the right run then he will be storming home late. OUR WILD IRISH ROSE (3) and HEATHBERN BRUCE (1) are also chances.

BAY LA VILLE (7) finds an easier race today after running second in a heat of the Southern Cross on Saturday. She finishes off her races well and she should get a great run into the race from the second row today. DARLINGTON (6) was very impressive last start when she broke her maiden. Today will be tougher but she is worth consideration because she has massive potential and plenty of improvement ahead of her. BERSAGLIERE (2) and BUSTNLOOSE (4) are also chances.

REACH THE PEAK (6) led all of the way at Port Pirie last start in what was a dominant performance where he won by 11.6 meters. He is a big chance today if he can repeat that sort of run. SRIRACHA (8), KETO (9) and ALORA (5) are all big chances in a very even race.

B T CAPTIVATE (6) finds a much easier race today compared to recent outings. The draw is tough but if he is anywhere near his best then he should be hard to beat. ALOHA PRINCESS (9), AFTER THE CHASE (7) and CHARMING MAJOR (2) are also chances. REDS STAR DEAL (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from the ideal draw. He did some work early last time out in a race taken out by Sweet Rocky over Bonnies Cam. ROCKIN IN PARADISE (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader in the race REDS STAR DEAL (1). He was a winner two starts ago when securing a similar run to the one he is likely to get in this race. GLENLEDI BOY (5) is a horse that loves to be sat up and saved for one run. He secured a good run last time out and wasn’t beaten too far there in fourth behind Greatgreat Boulder. JACCKA COOPER (8) was a good winner last time out at this track rating good time. He should secure a good run behind the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: REDS STAR DEAL (1), ROCKIN IN PARADISE (7), GLENLEDI BOY (5), JACCKA COOPER (8) SUGGESTED BET: REDS STAR DEAL (1) to win.

THE TORQUE EFFECT (2) ran a quick third quarter last time out at this track and trip which just opened up the race enough for Digby Devil to get into the clear early enough to run her down late. She still rated good time in defeat and if she can lead again in this race she is likely to take plenty of running down. JUSTROLLINGAROUND (1) draws ideally in this race and should get a good run just behind the speed. She ran a good third first up and is likely to have derived benefit from the outing. NOTIONS (5) led last time out and scored a dominant win leading all the way. She may be shuffled back this time and can look to be running on late. NAUTIE GALVINATOR (10) has been racing well recently having run second his last two outings. He is likely to be shuffled back again in this race but should be running on strongly if the racve is run to suit. SELECTIONS: THE TORQUE EFFECT (2), JUSTROLLINGAROUND (1), NOTIONS (5), NAUTIE GALVINATOR (10) SUGGESTED BET: THE TORQUE EFFECT (2) to win.

ONE CHAIN ROAD (1) has excellent gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. He was able to lead last time out and took them all the way there beating Illbewatching. BEACH MAGIC (9) was shuffled back early last time out and ran on late into third. He should get a good run off the speed this time in a race which looks likely to generate a strong early tempo which should bring him right into calculations. THREEONEFIVE (6) got back last time out and was able to run over the top holding off the late challenge of PERFECT LOU (3). She has impressed in recent outings and despite the wide draw can run well again. PERFECT LOU (3) made up good late ground into second last time out but just couldn’t quite reel in THREEONEFIVE (6). He can settle closer this time and should run well. SELECTIONS: ONE CHAIN ROAD (1), BEACH MAGIC (9), THREEONEFIVE (6), PERFECT LOU (3) SUGGESTED BET: BEACH MAGIC (9) to win.

LITTLE SURFER GIRL (2) was running on nicely late last time out into fourth at this track in good time behind Digby Devil. She seems to be a horse best suited to leading when she is in the right grade and may be able to do that in this race which should see her hard to beat. LITTLEMICKEY (6) was able to lead last time out and took them all the way there. He draws widest this time but should secure a good run off the speed and can be running on late. NEEDAREASON (1) draws ideally in this race and will have options in the early stages. She got back last time out and battled on late into fifth behind Digby Devil. PENNIE PACKER (4) secured a good run last time out and just couldn’t quite finish it off behind LITTLEMICKEY (6). She may be better suited not sitting so close to the speed this time and can run a better race this time. SELECTIONS: LITTLE SURFER GIRL (2), LITTLEMICKEY (6), NEEDAREASON (1), PENNIE PACKER (4) SUGGESTED BET: LITTLE SURFER GIRL (2) to win.

DIGBY JOY (7) looks likely to get the perfect run through in this race behind the likely leader in the race EBONY BELLE (1). She was running on nicely late last time out into second behind Erasmus. EBONY BELLE (1) should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from an ideal draw. She led two starts ago and was just run down late there by Miss Hattie who secured a good run off the speed. JUKEBOX JET (8) has been closing in on another win but just hasn’t quite been able to get there. He looks likely to secure a good run off the speed in this race and should be running on well late. SNIP OF BEAUTY (6) looks likely to be shuffled back early and will be needing the race run to suit. She has been racing well and appears well graded. SELECTIONS: DIGBY JOY (7), EBONY BELLE (1), JUKEBOX JET (8), SNIP OF BEAUTY (6) SUGGESTED BET: DIGBY JOY (7) to win.

BETTER ONE (7) didn’t have much luck first up when getting back and running on strongly into second behind Blackjack Sam. He was then able to find the front last time out taking them all the way and winning nicely. He draws awkwardly but appears the class runner. SAN LUCA (5) draws awkwardly towards the outside of the front row in this race which appears to make things tricky on paper. He trialled up nicely winning a recent trial at Menangle beating Wicked Motion. HARRY THE HAT (6) was able to find the front two starts ago and scored nicely there leading all the way. He draws awkwardly this time and may be forced to do some work at some stage. SWEET TIMES (1) should have the speed to lead early before having options from there. He was a winner first up when leading and controlling things before taking on a stronger race last time out. SELECTIONS: BETTER ONE (7), SAN LUCA (5), HARRY THE HAT (6), SWEET TIMES (1) SUGGESTED BET: BETTER ONE (7) to win.

MAGIC JUJON (6) draws widest in this race on return having won a recent trial by a huge margin over lesser opposition. She should be able to press forward in this race and looks the one to beat despite the draw. MOONSHINE MILLY (4) isn’t a horse noted for having much gate speed which could see him shuffled back in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He was a good winner four starts ago getting back and running over the top late. PICCOLO DIAVOLO (2) should get a good run behind the speed in this race from a good draw. He was forced to race without cover last time out and just faded late but may just be better suited driven quietly in his races. LOSTANDFOUND (1) should be able to lead initially from a good draw before having options from there. He ran well last time out for fourth behind Toro Loco at Albion Park. SELECTIONS: MAGIC JUJON (6), MOONSHINE MILLY (4), PICCOLO DIAVOLO (2), LOSTANDFOUND (1) SUGGESTED BET: MAGIC JUJON (6) to win.

CALL IT BLING (5) draws a touch awkwardly in this race but does look to be a standout on class. He got back last time out and couldn’t get into the race late which was taken out in good time by Jaccka Cooper. HIGHNMIGHTY (3) ran a better race last time out when getting back and running on late into sixth. She should settle close in this race from a good draw and can be running on late again. MACK ATTACK (4) got shuffled back last time out and couldn’t get into the race late behind Im Busted. He should settle closer this time and if the race is run to suit he can be running on late. SURPRISE BABY (2) sat without cover last time out and was able to prove too good there. He hasn’t raced for close to a month but should secure a good run close to the speed and will get his chance. SELECTIONS: CALL IT BLING (5), HIGHNMIGHTY (3), MACK ATTACK (4), SURPRISE BABY (2) SUGGESTED BET: CALL IT BLING (5) to win.

BROADWAYBEAUTY (4) smashed the clock in a recent trial rating 1.53.4 winning by a big margin there. If she goes anywhere near repeating that effort in this race it’ll be times and margins. She looks likely to be one of the shortest priced favourites of the week. FLIRTACIOUS MISS (1) ran well last time out when running on strongly into second behind Wildstar Diva. She draws well this time and if she can bring her best manners she looks to have good place claims. GOLDCLASS (7) should get a good run through early in this race. She didn’t have much luck last time out when getting back and making a wide run into it late. KISS ME LIKE THIS (6) took on a good race at Albion Park won by Exit Eleven where she battled away well for a close up seventh. She can be running on late. SELECTIONS: BROADWAYBEAUTY (4), FLIRTACIOUS MISS (1), GOLDCLASS (7), KISS ME LIKE THIS (6) SUGGESTED BET: FLIRTACIOUS MISS (1) to place.
